text:
Alex: Ping — PR #43812 is blocked on CI, need 1 more approval to merge. Failing only on mac-arm-12 image tests.
Maya: I can take a look, what's the exact job? link: https://buildkite.example/teams/redwood/pipelines/main/builds/43812
Alex: job: integ-mac-arm/image-render (macos-12-arm64). Failure is a visual snapshot diff in render_test::canvas_smoke.
Kevin: can you paste the failing assertion? I only see the screenshot diff in artifacts.
Alex: sure — from logs:
```
AssertionError: snapshot mismatch
expected sha: a1b2c3...
actual   sha: d4e5f6...
```
Sasha: hmm that diff looks like anti-aliasing jitter, not functional. We saw similar on Big Sur runners after the pkg update.
Maya: is this deterministic locally on mac-arm? Alex, did you try `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test render_test::canvas_smoke -- --nocapture`?
Alex: tried local on mac intel, can't repro. No access to arm CI locally.
ci-bot: buildkite: integ-mac-arm/image-render failed after 18m — artifacts uploaded: /artifacts/43812/1
Kevin: If it's visual noise, we can opt to approve+merge and follow up with a snapshot update PR, but need owner sign-off.
Maya: I'm comfortable to approve if test is flaky; can one of the runtime owners confirm no behavior change. @Sasha?
Sasha: assign to me for a quick bisect. I can reproduce on a mac-arm VM tomorrow morning and confirm.
Alex: thanks. Meanwhile can someone trigger a targeted rerun for just that job? Buildkite rerun -> job 3221.
Maya: done: @ci-bot rerun job 3221
ci-bot: buildkite: rerun requested by Maya for job 3221 — queued
ci-bot: buildkite: rerun complete — job 3221 passed (flaky)
Kevin: great — that's a one-off pass. Sasha, if you can't repro tomorrow, let's go ahead and merge with Maya's approve.
Sasha: if I can't repro I'll post a follow-up with snapshot delta or a skip-on-arm comment.
Alex: adding a note in PR with reproducer steps and linking the artifacts. @Maya — once you're happy can you drop the approval?
Maya: approved. :thumbsup:
Alex: merging now, will watch post-merge CI and open a tracking bug if it recurs.
Sasha: thx — I'll check morning and follow up if needed.
